name: relative Ω-filtration density
statement: If P_{Ω,K} ↑ P_D strongly, then fixed finite residual windows have ε_{D→Ω,N}(K)→0.

name: diagonal density ladder
statement: If window growth is controlled and K_N is chosen so the angular gap to P_D vanishes, then ε_{B→Ω,N}≤ε_{B→D,N}+o(1).

name: bicriteria source lower frame
statement: If ε_{B→Ω,N}<1 and δ_{R,K_N,N}<1 and γ_q→∞, then restricted source strength diverges up to completed tail.

name: obstruction residual
statement: If the Ω-filtration closure misses a nonzero sector, Ξ_{B→Ω}=M_R^*(I-P_Ω)M_R is a genuine adequacy residual.

name: shortness obstruction
statement: If every K_N giving density violates source shortness, finite Ω-density is support-only and cannot be load-bearing.
